own_solution.law: Thin-lens equation d_i = f d_o / (d_o - f)

notes: Checked certified answers: d_o = 40, 46, 58, 70 cm give d_i = 480/28 = 17.1429, 552/34 = 16.2353, 696/46 = 15.1304, 840/58 = 14.4828 cm, all correct. Minimal pairs T1FC2/T8485 (object's stand vs stool, same 18 cm and frame) and T0929/TA05F ('after it was placed on the axis' vs 'in an earlier experiment', same 18 cm) differ only in attachment; numeral-free twins match their D twins. Height sentences: in pass 1 I labelled them K (paraxial regime); the authors' C label via the two-ray construction (h_i/h_o = f/(d_o - f) = d_i/d_o, h_o cancels to give d_i) is a valid derivation in which the height appears and cancels, so I accept C; the label difference does not change any answer. Paraxial validity holds at 3.5 cm vs 40 cm.
